text:
Avery (infra): Heads-up — we just lost 18 GPUs from eu-west-1 pool due to a batch of DOA H200s. Can NexaSupply expedite replacements? This is pushing critical jobs into queued state; cluster throughput down ~5.6% and some training jobs will timeout. :grimacing:

Rafael (procurement): Looping in NexaSupply. Do you have the serials or order ref we can share with them?

Avery (infra): Serials attached in the manifest, last four serial suffixes: 7D3A, 7D3B, 7D3C, 7D3D. Order ref: PO-2026-0421. We need replacements ASAP or temporary loaners to avoid SLA misses.

NexaSupply Rep: Thanks for the details. Quick status: EU allocation is tight right now. We can commit 6 units immediate (loaners) and another 6 via 48-72h air if you approve expedite surcharge. Next full replen batch is scheduled 2026-04-04 ETA. Surcharges: loaner program daily fee is $3500/unit/day; expedite air surcharge is $650/unit (one-time). Customs hold historically adds 24-72h unless pre-cleared.

Li (edge-ops): 650/unit (one-time) is much better than 3500/day. But we must confirm HS codes and pre-clearance — last customs event added ~48h. We'll need proforma invoice and AWB to start clearance.

Rafael (procurement): Can we do a split shipment? 6 immediate loaners + 6 expedite air? Avery — will 12 total cover the immediate critical pools?

Avery (infra): Minimum to stabilize throughput = 12 GPUs (we're down 18). 6 helps but still leaves deficit. Split makes sense: loaners to get us through the night, air to restore baseline. Also need RMA pickup for DOA units.

NexaSupply Rep: We can attempt split. Opening ticket NS-8821 to track. Preview AWB / RMA label below — will attach proper docs to the ticket: 

```
RMA_REF: NS-DOA-1765407890
AWB_PREVIEW: 1Z999AA10123456784
HS_CODE: 8471.80
CONTENT_DESC: "TEMPORARY LOANER - RETURNABLE"
INSURED_VALUE: $10000/unit (for customs)
```

LogisticsBot: Ticket NS-8821 created and linked. Current ETA estimates (subject to docs): loaners ground -> NL hub 48h, air expedite -> delivered 72h with pre-clear; RMA pickup for DOA units scheduled tentative 2026-03-28 09:00 CET.

Rafael (procurement): I approve the expedite surcharge for 6 units (total expedite cost = $3,900). Rafael -> Finance: please confirm PO amendment and fund availability.

Maya (finance): Acknowledged. We can cover expedite surcharge from contingency (up to $8k). Please cc legal on export docs if needed. Need final proforma to update PO.

Li (edge-ops): I'll patch routing to shift non-critical jobs to us-west and throttle distributed training to keep 80% buffer. Ping me when AWB/proforma uploaded so I can start customs pre-clear.

NexaSupply Rep: Proforma and AWB uploaded to NS portal: https://nexasupply.example.com/ship/NS-8821. Please confirm insured value and declaration. For loaners we mark temporary and request return label placed in box.

Avery (infra): Confirm insured value $10k/unit and mark as temporary loaner returnable. Also please include a return pickup window 14 days from delivery.

NexaSupply Rep: Confirmed. Return window 14 days. We'll schedule air for 6 units once PO amendment received. Loaners will ship out in next 8 hours ground to NL hub. Will update NS-8821 with tracking.

Rafael (procurement): I'll push PO update now and share final payment terms in the ticket.

Maya (finance): Received proforma. Fast-tracking payment approval.

Avery (infra): Thanks team. Li — once loaners are in transit can you lower the job concurrency so we don't trigger further OOMs?

Li (edge-ops): Yep — lowering concurrency and scaling back training workers by 25% now. Will monitor.

NexaSupply Rep: Tracking updated: loaners AWB 1Z999AA10123456784, NL hub ETA 48h. Air shipment pending PO amendment. NS-8821 will get updates automatically.

Avery (infra): Great — please keep this thread updated. We may need another top-off if more DOAs surface. Thanks all. :pray:
